attempts.summary: Deployed a 3-node RabbitMQ 3.10.0 cluster (node1/node2/node3, RHEL 7.9) serving AMQP over TLS on port 5671 using a self-signed benchmark CA created for this cluster. mTLS is enforced (verify_peer + fail_if_no_peer_cert), so only clients presenting a certificate issued by that CA can complete the AMQP TLS handshake; the management UI/API on 15672 is bound to each node's private IP and firewalld-restricted to the 10.100.143.0/24 cluster subnet only. Ran the mandatory one-at-a-time node-restart protocol on all three nodes, confirming changed boot IDs and full cluster/TLS/firewall recovery after each restart.
